Players Committee card image of [[Rogue One (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “May add 2 pilots and 4 passengers. May deploy with a pilot to a system without presence or Force icons. Spies deploy -1 aboard. Immune to attrition < 6 at opponent system (unless a Dark Jedi here).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/rogueone.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb9f1e88dd679e4fa7860bc7cc8b6032d3476e13 eb9f1e8] (22 April 2024). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
